page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Enhanced family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.9 GHz. The instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The memory configuration comprises 128 GB of RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB per virtual core. It features a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, operates without bundled local storage, and includes no discrete graphics processing hardware.

Benchmark results show balanced compute output across standard integer, cryptographic, and floating-point workloads, with PassMark CPU scoring at 36,697.24 and Geekbench multi-core reaching 13,323.0. Memory subsystem testing reflects strong throughput, placing in the top 25% with a PassMark memory score of 2,777.67 and an uncached 256 MB read bandwidth of 147.22 GB/sec. Instruction set extensions including AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI support vector operations and machine learning tasks, demonstrated by small 135M model LLM text generation running in the top tier at 301.47 tokens per second.

Because the instance does not feature integrated local disks, persistent storage must be provisioned externally over the network interface. The dedicated core allocation and balanced memory density offer stable compute efficiency without the volatility of shared-core configurations. These attributes align the server with enterprise software compilation, medium-scale container orchestration, in-memory datastores, backend application serving, and steady-state relational databases relying on remote block storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.8xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs and 16 physical cores based on the Intel Xeon 8369B processor at 2.9 GHz. It is configured with 128 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio, and operates with a 10 Gbps baseline network capacity. The server includes no local disk storage or hardware accelerators, requiring external volumes for persistence. Benchmark evaluations indicate consistent middle-tier performance across multi-core compute tests alongside strong memory performance in the upper quartile, scoring 2,777.67 on PassMark Memory. In addition, AVX-512 VNNI extensions assist specialized inference workloads, achieving 301.47 tokens per second on lightweight language models. This hardware balance makes the instance suitable for distributed backend applications, Redis caching nodes, software build systems, and general enterprise workloads.
